title: Maintenance Service Specialist (1st Shift)
description:
Ready to join our team? Apply today! Make sure to check your email for follow-ups.

At MicroPort, we relentlessly strive to master every detail of our medical solutions with the purpose of prolonging and reshaping the lives of patients everywhere. We welcome motivated and talented people who want to join our dynamic and inclusive company, working together to deliver meaningful medical breakthroughs. In order to accomplish this, we hold true to our core values of Quality, Integrity, Accountability, Efficiency, Innovation, Aspiration, Dedication & Collaboration. Come and join Team MicroPort!

Why You’ll Love MicroPort

You will find our team atmosphere challenging and rewarding. In addition to working with a world-class team, receiving a competitive base salary and bonus opportunities, our U.S. employees also enjoy the following benefits: Medical, Dental, Vision, Maternity Leave, Life Insurance, Short-Term Disability, Long-Term Disability, Bereavement, 401(k) (up to 4% match with vesting from day 1), PTO, Paid Holidays, Employee Assistance Program, Education Assistance...and more! At MicroPort, we care about our employees and encourage them to make healthy lifestyle choices and embrace wellness opportunities to maintain their very best health and wellbeing.

1st shift: 7:00am-3:30pm, Monday-Friday

Overall Summary

As Maintenance Service Specialist, you will perform maintenance on both CNC and Manual equipment. The Maintenance Specialist will assist outside OEM technicians to gain experience in repairing and set-up of new equipment.

Your duties will include:

• Perform troubleshooting and evaluates mechanical, hydraulic, and electrical unit and controls to determine source of malfunction.

• Uses blueprints, machine specifications, and schematic drawings to determine repair procedures.

• Removes and replaces defective units, controls, or components. Tests and repairs components such as PC boards, power supplies, and controls stations with oscilloscopes, VOM’s, logic probe

• Adjusts sensitive electrical, thermal, and timing devices to machine specifications.

• Starts repaired and/or new equipment to verify readiness for operation.

• Complies with all health, safety and environmental policies, procedures.

• Must have valid current driver’s license to drive to local vendors for repair parts and supplies.

• Perform preventive maintenance on all equipment.

• Assist outside contractors, i.e.: fire systems, insurance inspectors, etc.

• Responsible for monitoring all daily Industrial Wastewater Discharge Points (pH pits and Outfalls)

Other Duties: Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

About You

We might be a great match if you have:

• Ability to replace ball screws, servo motors, solenoid valve, control boards.

• Willingness to obtain aerial and forklift license within the first year after starting.

• Proficiency in soldering, welding, and fabricating.

• VOM, clamp on Ammeter, Hammers, pliers, and wrenches.

Licensure, Registration and/or Certification

Driver’s license is required

Current forklift and aerial license required or must be willing to obtain forklift and aerial license within first 6 months of hire.

YOUR EDUCATION

Required: High School Diploma or GED

Preferred: Associate's Degree in Industrial Maintenance Technology or related technical field strongly preferred

YOUR EXPERIENCE

I: At least 1 year experience as a Machine Maintenance Technician involving electrical, hydraulic, and pneumatic systems, including repairing CNC equipment OR minimum one year experience as Machinist.

II: At least 3 years' experience as a Machine Maintenance Technician involving electrical, hydraulic, and pneumatic systems, including repairing CNC equipment.

Overall Summary

As Supervisor, Production, you will supervise all aspects of both lean value stream and traditional manufacturing product lines across all shifts. You will also mentor direct reports to further develop the skills required for their job functions and interface with engineering, production, quality, scheduling, and corporate work teams to facilitate manufacturing operation.

Your duties will include:

• Supervise multiple product lines and the manufacturing activities throughout the value streams.

• Competently plan, organize, and direct manufacturing operations to a defined budget, ensuring alignment with daily, weekly, and monthly production targets.

• Maintain and improve manpower utilization to maximize employee efficiencies.

• Set goals and objectives, measure progress to drive accountability for achieving daily, weekly, and monthly performance targets across safety, quality, delivery, and cost metrics and strive for a continuous improvement culture.

• Lead a structured operating cadence (e.g., shift start-up meetings, daily tier meetings, and weekly performance reviews) to communicate priorities, monitor KPIs, and address performance gaps.

• Ensure consistent follow-through on corrective actions, process improvements, and commitments to meet operational goals and drive continuous improvement.

• Develop and train employees, conduct personnel reviews, and foster a culture of ownership, accountability, and results-driven performance

• Enforce the company personnel policies through a consistent application of principles, while maintaining a robust training program.

• Proactively identify, escalate, and resolve production, quality, or delivery risks, ensuring timely mitigation and minimal disruption to operations.

• Understand and adhere to all FDA, GMP and ISO requirements.

Other Duties Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice

We might be a great match if you have:

• strong leadership skills including organizational skills, the ability to formulate and execute plans and the ability to instill teamwork within the subordinate group.

• excellent communication skills, both verbal and written.

YOUR EDUCATION

Required:  High School Diploma

Preferred: Bachelor's Degree

YOUR EXPERIENCE

Minimum 1 year of supervisory experience in a manufacturing environment required

• Experience in some or all of the following disciplines highly preferred: medical device manufacturing, foundry, CNC machining, metal finishing, cleaning of metals / plastics, packaging, quality.

• Training and/or experience in the following is preferred: GMP, GD&T, lean manufacturing, mainframe computer systems, Microsoft office applications.
